title: Paquatuck (Terrell River)
summary: Paquatuck names the creek or tidal river now known as Terrell River, on the line between East Moriches and Center Moriches in Brookhaven. The name appears in colonial boundary language for Moriches Neck.
map_geometry_source: Approximate Terrell River / East Moriches-Center Moriches landscape point based on Tooker location; coordinate needs local map review.
history_content: Terrell River location, Moriches Neck boundary context, and related archaeological landscape is brought together here. Boundary and archaeology details appear in the historic moments below.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Paquatuck, Pacotuck, Poquatuck, and Pautuck. The name is interpreted as a clear or open creek, from language for open or clear and a tidal river or creek.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names are not just geographic markers. They are cultural artifacts – fragments of memory that map out history, belief, and the shape of everyday life.”

— Aika Rey, What Barangay names reveal about the Filipino soul (2025), Article introduction
whereintheworld_content: Map location note: on Terrell River between Center Moriches and East Moriches. The map marker orients readers and is not an exact boundary for the Paquatuck place.
